node.statement: Proposition 2.2 (Jucys-Murphy product): For n >= 1, (e + X_n)(e + X_{n-1})...(e + X_1) = sum_{pi in S_n} pi, where X_k = sum_{j=1}^{k-1} (j,k) are the Jucys-Murphy elements and e is the identity. Proof by induction on n: base case n=1 is trivial (X_1 = 0). Inductive step: (e + X_{n+1}) sum_{pi in S_n} pi = sum_{pi in S_n} pi + sum_{pi in S_n} sum_{j=1}^{n} (j,n+1) pi. Every permutation in S_{n+1} either fixes n+1 (the first sum) or doesn't (the second sum covers all such cases by choosing j = pi^{-1}(n+1) after the transposition).
